quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangfeng Electronic Materials results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Director and CFO Yu Yongqun (2025 annual results briefing): fixed assets rose sharply because several projects - the raised-fund ultra-high-purity sputtering target projects and semiconductor precision-parts projects - partly entered production in 2025; the lower precision-parts gross margin reflects capacity ramp-up, integration and efficiency work at its production bases after broadening the precision-parts product line, plus the high initial cost of introducing many new and R&D products. The company is accelerating construction and expansion of its electrostatic chuck and brittle-materials projects.
